Middle Eastern food delivery in Metro Manila, Rizal & Bulacan

Arbab Kebab is a Middle Eastern restaurant serving charcoal-grilled shawaya (whole roast chicken), chicken and beef kabsa, chicken biryani, beef and chicken kebab, shawarma wraps, falafel, hummus, fattoush and tabbouleh — with our tomato chutney and garlic paste on the side. Order online for delivery or pick-up from our branches in Makati, Pasig, Diliman and Fairview (Quezon City), Marikina, C6 Banaba (San Mateo, Rizal) and Malolos (Bulacan).

Do you deliver?

Yes — we offer delivery and contactless delivery, plus pick-up. We'll confirm the delivery fee for your area when we reply to your order.

How do I order?

Add dishes to your cart, enter your details, and tap “Place Order.” For GCash, you'll go to the payment page to pay and submit your reference number.

How can I pay?

Pay by GCash using the link after placing your order, or choose cash on delivery or pickup. Delivery fees are settled separately from GCash food payments.

Where are your branches?

We have 7 branches: Makati, Pasig, Diliman (Quezon City), Fairview (Quezon City), Marikina, C6 Banaba (San Mateo, Rizal) and Malolos (Bulacan). When you pin your delivery location, the order form picks the nearest branch for you.

What time can I order for?

You can schedule delivery or pick-up for today or a later date, in hourly slots from 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

What should I try first?

Our Shawaya sets — charcoal-grilled whole chicken with tomato chutney and garlic paste — are the house favorite. For groups, the Potluck and Shawaya Potluck are good for 4–6 people.

Do you cater for parties and offices?

Our potlucks and meal sets are made for sharing. For bigger orders, message us on Facebook or call us.

1. Add your favorites to your order.
